第31章 不想死就抓紧加固门窗-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》

眼前蜂蜜水散发香气，味道与蓝星绝对不同，但都是一样香甜。

许默没有推辞，接过木杯仰起头灌下一大口。

他屋内快速扫了一圈。

“那小丑东西跑哪去了？”

方芸随手用木勺指向屋角。

曼德拉草正端端正正地把自己安排在花盆中。

它故意留出三片叶子，叶片能量流转，微微探向门外，感受着外面的光。

许默扣除理智，开启buff查看。

【家具·荆棘花盆】

【当前种植：荆棘曼德拉草（紫阶）】

【年份：十年】

【状态：正逐渐发生变异……】

他嘴角微微抽动，伸出手去摸曼德拉草的叶片。

原本光滑的脉络上，此刻竟然已经能摸到细微坚硬的倒刺。

这花盆竟然对曼德拉草也有同化作用。

看着盆里的小丑东西，他琢磨着可能是缺营养。

于是，他从储物格里抠出一点散发着异味的鸟粪肥，均匀地撒在花盆内缘，又往土里浇了小半杯清水。

做完这一切，他反手从怀里摸出那块从死者身上摸来的惨白骨牌。

没有任何犹豫，意念一动。

【吞噬】

掌心骤然升温，那块坚硬的骨牌在短短几秒内寸寸龟裂，最终化作一蓬惨白的骨灰顺着指缝洒落，连一点残渣都没剩下。

视网膜上爆出一团刺眼的蓝光。

【吞噬完成】

【检测到残留灵魂碎片，可升级技能一次。】

【请选择分支方向：洞察、天气、体能……】

许默盯着那一长串选项，眉头紧锁。

“这东西的技能树太杂了。”

方芸闻声放下手里的木勺，凑过来看了一眼半空中的虚拟光幕。

“选身体属性方向。这座庇护所的核心绑定权在我身上，建筑防御有我兜底，你现在的首要任务是把身体素质提上来，否则下一次遇到黑影，我们连抵抗的能力都没有。”

许默目光微沉。

思索片刻，觉得方芸说的不无道理。

于是，直接点向了体能强化分支。

The honey water in front of me exudes fragrance. The taste is definitely different from Blue Star, but it is still as sweet.

Xu Mo didn't refuse, took the wooden cup, raised his head and took a big gulp.

He took a quick look around the house.

"Where did that clown thing go?"

Fang Yun pointed the wooden spoon at the corner of the room.

The mandrake is arranging itself neatly in the flowerpot.

It deliberately leaves three leaves, and the energy of the leaves flows, slightly leaning out of the door, feeling the light outside.

Xu Mo deducted his sanity and turned on the buff to check.

[Furniture·Thorn Flower Pot]

[Current planting: Thorn Mandrake (Purple Level)]

[Year: ten years]

[Status: Mutations are gradually occurring...]

The corner of his mouth twitched slightly, and he stretched out his hand to touch the leaves of the mandrake.

On the originally smooth veins, now you can actually feel tiny hard barbs.

This flower pot actually has an assimilation effect on mandrake.

Looking at the clown stuff in the basin, he thought it might be due to lack of nutrients.

So he dug out some smelly bird manure from the storage grid, spread it evenly on the inner edge of the flower pot, and poured half a cup of water into the soil.

After doing all this, he took out the pale domino from the deceased's body with his backhand.

There was no hesitation, just a thought.

【Swallow】

The palm of the hand suddenly heated up, and the hard domino cracked inch by inch in just a few seconds, and finally turned into a pile of pale ashes and scattered along the fingers, leaving not even a trace of residue.

A blinding blue light exploded on the retina.

[Swallowing completed]

[When residual soul fragments are detected, skills can be upgraded once.】

[Please select a branch direction: insight, weather, physical fitness...]

Xu Mo stared at the long list of options, frowning.

"The skill tree of this thing is too complicated."

Fang Yun put down the wooden spoon in her hand when she heard the sound, and came over to take a look at the virtual light curtain in mid-air.

"Choose the direction of physical attributes. The core binding power of this shelter rests with me, and I am responsible for the building's defense. Your first priority now is to improve your physical fitness. Otherwise, the next time we encounter the black shadow, we will not even have the ability to resist."

Xu Mo's eyes darkened slightly.

After thinking for a moment, I felt that what Fang Yun said made sense.

So, he directly clicked on the physical strengthening branch.
